title: Ash & Ale
description: This modpack is the official set of mods for the "Ash & Ale" modded minecraft server, our modpack focuses heavily on medieval and magic themes. On Ash & Ale, players are encouraged to form teams with each other, form relationships with other groups, and fi
body: Step into a magical, medieval world where your choices shape history! Team up with friends, form alliances—or rivalries—and fight to protect your lands. Every action leaves a mark on the world of Ash & Ale.
